note: Client retry policy (one model for every SDK). Classified by status, code and, for 429, the detail prefix.

classes.never: no retry: 400, 401, 403, 404, and 429 whose detail starts with "Throttling Exception: Exceeded token limit"
classes.once-after-burst-wait: one retry after at least 10 s (configurable, can be off): 429 whose detail starts with "Throttling Exception: Exceeded rate limit"
classes.backoff: exponential backoff: 5xx, non-JSON gateway errors and network errors, POST search included

requestId: one X-Request-Id per logical call, reused on every retry
